title: Entrance Fee Agreement Discounts on Assisted Living Rent and Care Fee Charges
content:
**Life Plan member bulletin — Assisted Living Residency and Care Agreement.**

**The level-increase charge.** An Entrance Fee Agreement in occupied status discounts the level-increase charge inside the charge, and no separate plan discount credit follows it:

- an agreement whose **occupancy date is at least 60 whole months before the handling date** reduces the charge by the plan's **full care fee discount percentage**;
- an occupied agreement of **shorter standing** reduces it by **0.5 of that percentage**;
- without an occupied agreement the charge is not reduced under this bulletin.

The reduction applies to what remains of the charge after any amount subtracted from it, before the charge is rounded once to the cent.

**Every other rent and care fee charge.** Every other rent charge and care fee charge of a customer holding an Entrance Fee Agreement in occupied status keeps its separate entrance plan discount credit referencing that charge and the agreement, at the plan's rent discount percentage or care fee discount percentage applied to the charge amount and rounded to the cent half up once the occupancy date is at least 60 whole months old on the posting date, and at 0.5 of those percentages before then.

The percentages are those of the agreement's plan in the Entrance Fee Agreement terms. Whole months are counted from the occupancy date, a whole month being completed each time the count reaches the same day of the month as the occupancy date. For the level-increase charge the count runs to the handling date; for the separate credits it runs to the posting date of the charge.

### Illustrations (hypothetical plan: care fee discount 10 percent, rent discount 5 percent)

| Item | Agreement standing | Result |
|---|---|---|
| Level-increase charge of 392.666… before rounding | 60 whole months or more | 392.666… reduced by 10 percent: 353.40, no separate credit |
| Same charge | Under 60 whole months | Reduced by 5 percent: 373.03, no separate credit |
| Full-month rent charge of 4285.00 | 60 whole months or more on the posting date | Separate credit of 5 percent: 214.25 |
| Same rent charge | Under 60 whole months on the posting date | Separate credit of 2.5 percent: 107.125, rounded half up to 107.13 |
| Any charge | Agreement not in occupied status, or none | No reduction and no credit |
